tagline: Games, quizzes and one stubborn iOS app. Built by hand, one project at a time.
description: Paj's playground: browser games, anime quizzes, and a devlog about building TAG, an iOS app for a month-long game of real-life tag.
status:
### TAG — where the app is right now

**Stage 2 is done.** The app plays the whole game against a live backend: accounts, gangs with invite codes, GPS-verified tags, the timeline, statistics, the hunt, the map, UAVs, truces, Bluetooth indoors, an album of evidence and a Hall of Shame that remembers every year.

Migrations 1 to 15 are running in production. 44 unit tests, 212 database assertions and four interface tests that play the real game against the real backend.

**Next up:** stage 3 — design polish, the privacy policy, and TestFlight.

**Blocking:** the Apple Developer Program, which I have decided not to buy until the app deserves it. Until then the alerts are local ones the phone raises itself, and the Bluetooth side waits for two real phones.
